## Summary

Describe the behavior changed and why.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and failure paths.
- [ ] `make release-check PYTHON=.venv/bin/python` passes.
- [ ] Metrics include their command, configuration, data manifest and raw report.
- [ ] Model or technology selection changes include an ADR and project-specific comparison.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, model weights or generated traces are committed.
- [ ] Sealed evaluation data was not inspected or reused for tuning.

## Risk

Describe business-write, policy, privacy, evaluation-leakage or compatibility risk.
